documents.doc-cz-msp-2026-09-08-msp-19-2026-odka-r: The Minister of Justice treated the submissions delivered on 12 July, 15 July, 10 August and 25 August 2026 as a request for measures against inactivity under Section 80(2) of the Administrative Procedure Code. He found the request unfounded, declined to take an inactivity measure and stated that the filing of 12 July 2026 was disposed of by this letter. He also stated that a settlement cannot be concluded in the administrative action and that further filings without new material facts may be placed on file without further written notice.
